fields.subject: Postgres Type Mapping
fields.trigger: a Query contract selects a Double or Real input with NaN, or a Uuid input with Guid.Empty, through the non-nullable overload
fields.response: append an Input parameter with the selected PostgreSQL type and database null rather than the sentinel value; this is deliberate (by design), mirroring the read-side sentinels where GetDouble/GetFloat return NaN and GetGuid returns Guid.Empty for a database null; a caller that must send the sentinel value itself uses the Nullable overload, which maps only null to database null

sources.label: read-side NaN / Guid.Empty null sentinels (by design)
